skills.name: get-site-info
skills.description: Return Notofilia site identity and the URLs of agent discovery documents (MCP, OpenAPI, OAuth, llms.txt, skills index). Use when bootstrapping an agent or listing how to talk to the site.

skills.name: health-check
skills.description: Check whether Notofilia agent APIs are healthy. Use before catalog search or when diagnosing a failed MCP/REST call.

skills.name: list-comments
skills.description: List approved public comments on a Noticias article by slug. Use for read-only discussion context. Posting a comment is out of scope (Turnstile and/or claimed agent identity).

skills.name: open-path
skills.description: Navigate a browser already on Notofilia to a site-relative path. Use with WebMCP when a human or browser agent should open a catalog hub, ficha, or editorial page.

skills.name: search-catalog
skills.description: Search Notofilia's historical banknote and coin catalog by title, path, or keywords. Use when an agent needs to find a ficha, confirm whether a piece is documented, or list matching catalog URLs. Pieces are not for sale.
